scenarios.name: exile-creature-controller-gains-power-life
scenarios.why: Exile target creature. Its controller gains life equal to its power: a 2/2 Grizzly Bears leaves the battlefield to exile and its controller gains exactly 2 life.

scenarios.name: target-leaves-in-response-spell-fizzles-no-life
scenarios.why: The target leaves the battlefield before the spell resolves (CR 608.2b: every target illegal, the spell does not resolve), so neither the exile nor the dependent life gain happens -- Ember Hauler is sacrificed by its own ability, deals its 2 damage, and p1 gains nothing.
